custom_logic_notes: This is a correlation-based pairs trading EA. It simultaneously opens two positions on two correlated currency pairs (Money1=chart symbol, Money2=user-specified). Direction is determined either manually or automatically based on session time and which currency is base/quote. Auto mode has two sub-modes: 'Direct' (opposite directions - hedge) and 'Inverted' (same direction). The EA uses a Sleep()-based monitoring loop after opening positions, polling OrderCalcProfit every 10ms until combined profit >= threshold or SL/TP hit. It then closes both positions with opposite market orders. The day-of-week filter blocks trading on disabled days. The custom 'Correlation' indicator is required and not a built-in MT5 indicator.
external_dependencies: Correlation custom indicator (iCustom call to 'Correlation' with Money2, Depth, AppliedPrice parameters)
backtest_data_needs: Multi-symbol tick data for two correlated pairs (e.g. EURUSD + USDCHF) with at least 730 days
python_conversion_notes: Requires multi-symbol data alignment, custom correlation indicator implementation (Pearson rolling correlation on applied price), pairs trading logic with combined P&L tracking, session-based currency direction bias, and simultaneous position management. The Sleep()-based monitoring loop must be converted to event-driven bar-by-bar evaluation. The SL/TP detection via HistoryDealGetTicket polling must be replaced with price-level comparison logic. Auto direction logic based on session times and currency position in pair name must be reimplemented.
